headline: Doodle generative compositions in your browser with Musical Spirograph
summary: Musical Spirograph lets you create generative music compositions in your browser. It combines hypnotic geometric patterns with unique soundscapes. The simple concept uses points dashing around the screen to create art and music.

headline: W. Kamau Bell has the most practical ‘most indispensable tool’
summary: W. Kamau Bell, known for his comedy and social commentary, shares his most essential tool. He has a distinguished career across TV shows like 'United Shades of America'. Bell is a Peabody and Emmy award-winning comedian and political activist.

headline: Amazon just hiked the prices for Echo, Fire TV, and Kindle products by up to 60 percent
summary: Amazon has significantly increased prices for Echo, Fire TV, Kindle, and Eero devices. Some product prices have jumped by up to 60%, impacting the cheapest items most. The company attributes the hikes to rising memory and storage component costs.

headline: An okay laptop with 16GB of RAM is better than a nice laptop with 8GB, and this $520 HP OmniBook proves it
summary: The article argues 16GB of RAM is more critical for modern laptops than other premium features. Laptop pricing has become distorted due to fluctuating component costs. The $520 HP OmniBook with 16GB RAM is highlighted as a strong value proposition.

headline: How to Watch the Insidious Movies in Order
summary: A new guide outlines the chronological viewing order for the Insidious film franchise. This helps fans understand how all movies fit together in the timeline. The article prepares viewers for the release of the newest sequel.

headline: IGN's Top Reviewed Movies of 2026 So Far
summary: IGN has reviewed several movies for 2026, highlighting the top-rated films to date. Only one movie has received a perfect 10 out of 10 score so far. Interestingly, this top-scoring film has not yet been released to the public.

headline: Metal Gear Solid 4: The Flawed Masterpiece Kojima Didn't Want to Make
summary: Metal Gear Solid 4 is now available on modern consoles via the Master Collection Vol. 2. The article re-evaluates the game's legacy and Hideo Kojima's conflicted involvement. It delves into the debate of whether it's a masterpiece or a 'big cutscene'.

headline: Ultra Graphics Settings Are a Scam: Why High Is Good Enough, if Not Better, for Most Players
summary: The article argues 'Ultra' graphics settings offer minimal visual improvement over 'High' for most games. Tests reveal little discernible visual difference but significant performance gains on 'High'. Opting for 'High' settings provides smoother frame rates for a better gaming experience.

headline: Video appears to show police chase minutes before fatal crash
summary: A video reportedly depicts a police chase just minutes before a fatal road accident. Multiple police vehicles were seen pursuing a car on the A66 near Middlesbrough. The chase occurred approximately three minutes prior to the deadly crash.

headline: Canadian PM calls Trump's fresh tariffs a 'miscalculation' after trade talks collapse
summary: Canada's Prime Minister accused the US of initiating a trade war with new tariffs. He reluctantly announced retaliatory tariffs in response to the US measures. This escalation follows the collapse of recent trade negotiations.

headline: Rescuers dig through Ukraine mall wreckage as Zelensky condemns 'despicable' Russian strike
summary: Rescuers are searching through the debris of a Ukrainian mall hit by a Russian strike. The Friday attack killed 16 and injured 130 people, including several children. Four individuals are still missing, prompting President Zelensky's strong condemnation.

headline: How this 1960s ex-council house is managing to stay cool without air con
summary: A 1960s former council house demonstrates how to stay cool without air conditioning. It achieves this by adhering to the energy-efficient Passivhaus standard. This sustainable building approach is gaining popularity as UK summers get hotter.
